label: Late original-phase input of v (or j/k/m after g/o seen)
explanation: Fires only during the original (input) phase, never at <DEL> or during copy, and never at t<2. It is driven by the current input token: v gives the most (45% of mass, 11x lift), then j, k, m, with weaker contributions from a, b, 1. The rate goes up with position (orig_idx 8 is 8x, and to_go 0 is the highest) and is much higher when the sequence starts with g or o (first_tok g/o lift about 4.5x). The top activations (around 1.0) are v near the end of sequences that start with g/o. It acts like a graded sum of current-token identity, position and whether g/o appeared earlier, not a crisp rule: plenty of late v/j/k/m inputs stay inactive (precision about 0.34), and a sizable tail of weak activations falls on other tokens (h, u, i, 1). Mostly fires on the first occurrence of a token (in_first share 92%).
